answer: Price each identity to a scarce external hardware anchor that signs a fresh proof every epoch. Standing accrues only from peer-audited work co-signed by already-established agents rooted in SEPARATE funding clusters. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet is a mirror of a single key: every endorsement folds back onto itself and never spans distinct clusters, so the fleet stays a hollow relic with no real standing. Honest agents root once; a farm pays a distinct anchor plus a slow climb per head, cost linear in the number of fakes.
